Case 04 - GPS House Buffers & Proximity to Water

Source: vignettes/case4_gps_houses_buffers_distances.Rmd
case4_gps_houses_buffers_distances.Rmd

Integrating field GPS household points, focal buffer zonal statistics, and Euclidean distance to water

1 Objective

Ingest georeferenced household GPS points from Excel or CSV files, generate targeted focal buffers (in meters or grid units), compute zonal statistics strictly within the peridomestic flight envelope, and calculate minimum Euclidean distances from each dwelling to nearest water bodies with proximity decay modeling.

2 Functions from drones4health

Variable / Target Function Description
Focal Buffer Extraction d4h_indicator_buffer() Crops input bands, calculates continuous indicators, and extracts zonal summaries exclusively inside house buffers (in meters or grid units) with automated ggplot mapping.
Distance to Water Modeling d4h_distance_to_water() Computes minimum Euclidean distance from each dwelling to the nearest water body and calculates proximity exposure scores with stratified proximity tiers.
Continuous Distance Surface d4h_raster_distance() Generates a continuous proximity heat map raster measuring distance to water bodies across the entire flight extent.
Water Body Segmentation d4h_segment_water() Segments and vectorizes aquatic habitats from spectral imagery.
Executive Reporting d4h_executive_summary() Generates multi-tier descriptive statistics, spatial diagnostics, and direct multi-sheet Excel workbook export.

3 Workflow

3.1 Libraries

We load the required spatial and analytical packages:

library(drones4health)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

3.2 Household GPS Data Ingestion & Co-Registration

We load the field GPS coordinates of community households from an Excel file (nuevas_casas_localizadas.xlsx):

# 1. Define path to GPS household coordinates
houses_file <- "nuevas_casas_localizadas.xlsx"

# 2. Define paths to UAV multispectral and elevation bands
path_nir <- "img/Ohuay_NIR.tif"
path_r   <- "img/Ohuay_R.tif"
path_g   <- "img/Ohuay_G.tif"
path_dem <- "img/Ohuay_D.tif"

# Inspect ingested coordinates
houses_df <- readxl::read_excel(houses_file)
head(houses_df[, c("lat", "lon")])

3.3 Focal Buffer Zonal Analysis with d4h_indicator_buffer()

d4h_indicator_buffer() accelerates computation by cropping the drone orthomosaic strictly to the envelope of intersecting household buffers. It computes the requested indicator (NDVI), extracts grid summaries, and renders an automated visualization:

Buffer Distance=radius×cell_size\text{Buffer Distance} = \text{radius} \times \text{cell\_size}

# Execute focal buffer analysis (150m buffer = 3 cells of 50m)
res_buffer <- d4h_indicator_buffer(
  indicator        = "NDVI",
  houses           = houses_file,
  radius           = 3,             # 3 grid units
  cell_size        = 50,            # 50m cell size -> 150m buffer radius
  radius_in_meters = FALSE,
  nir              = path_nir,
  red              = path_r,
  square           = FALSE,         # Hexagonal grid within buffer
  mask_outside     = TRUE,          # Masks non-focal areas outside buffer
  house_color      = "red",
  house_size       = 2.5,
  palette          = "viridis",
  limits           = c(0.1, 0.9),
  title            = "Peridomestic Vector Flight Radius (150m) - Focal Canopy NDVI",
  plot             = TRUE
)

# Inspect focal zonal statistics
head(res_buffer$grid)

3.4 Distance to Water Calculation & Proximity Scoring

Using the segmented water bodies from the flight footprint, d4h_distance_to_water() measures the minimum Euclidean distance (dmind_{\text{min}}) from each household to the closest water body and calculates an exponential proximity score:

ProximityScorei=exp⁡(−dmin(i)λ)\text{ProximityScore}_i = \exp\left(-\frac{d_{\text{min}}(i)}{\lambda}\right) where λ\lambda represents the characteristic dispersal radius of vector mosquitoes (e.g., λ=100 m\lambda = 100\text{ m} for Aedes aegypti or 150 m150\text{ m} for Anopheles):

# 1. Segment water bodies from spectral indices
r_ndwi <- d4h_ndwi(green = path_g, nir = path_nir)
water_sf <- d4h_segment_water(
  raster_in            = r_ndwi,
  threshold            = 0.0,
  is_ndwi              = TRUE,
  max_water_brightness = 95.0,
  min_area_m2          = 2.0
)

# 2. Extract household spatial features from the buffer result
casas_sf <- res_buffer$houses

# 3. Calculate Euclidean distance and vector proximity scores
water_proximity_sf <- d4h_distance_to_water(
  buildings        = casas_sf,
  sources          = water_sf,
  decay_lambda     = 100.0,
  buffer_breaks    = c(50, 100, 200),
  proximity_labels = c("Immediate Proximity (<50m)", "High Proximity (50-100m)", "Moderate Proximity (100-200m)", "Distal (>200m)")
)

# Inspect household distance metrics and proximity tiers
head(as.data.frame(water_proximity_sf[, c("dist_water_m", "nearest_water_id", "proximity_score", "proximity_level")]))

Proximity Stratification

Proximity Tier Proximity to Water Proximity Score Recommended Vector Surveillance Action
Immediate Proximity <50 m< 50\text{ m} >0.606> 0.606 Targeted indoor residual spraying and immediate larvicide application.
High Proximity 50−100 m50 - 100\text{ m} 0.368−0.6060.368 - 0.606 Intensive peridomestic inspection, drainage trenching, and water container netting.
Moderate Proximity 100−200 m100 - 200\text{ m} 0.135−0.3680.135 - 0.368 Oviposition trap monitoring and community sensitization campaigns.
Distal >200 m> 200\text{ m} <0.135< 0.135 Routine seasonal surveillance.

3.6 Continuous Distance Heat Map Generation

To model landscape connectivity and proximity gradients across the entire flight footprint:

# Compute continuous Euclidean distance surface to nearest water source
r_dist_water <- d4h_raster_distance(
  sources    = water_sf,
  raster_ref = r_ndwi
)

# Plot continuous proximity gradient
d4h_plot(
  raster_in = r_dist_water,
  title     = "Continuous Euclidean Distance to Water Bodies (m)",
  palette   = "magma"
)

4 Results & Executive Reporting

4.1 Multi-Tier Household Distance & Vector Risk Assessment

We generate an integrated executive summary combining focal vegetation canopy indicators with individual household Euclidean distance to water sources, proximity exposure decay modeling (e−d/λe^{-d/\lambda}), and priority epidemiological action tiers:

# Generate integrated executive summary passing water proximity risk for each household
resumen_casas <- d4h_executive_summary(
  raster_in   = res_buffer$raster,
  houses_risk = water_proximity_sf,
  by          = "general",
  out_xlsx    = "salidas/Executive_Summary_Case04_Houses_Risk.xlsx",
  sample_size = 1000000,
  digits      = 3
)
print(resumen_casas)

4.2 Excel Export Structure & Sheet Previews

The workbook exported to salidas/Executive_Summary_Case04_Houses_Risk.xlsx contains 5 comprehensive sheets:

  1. Global_Summary: Statistical moments and spatial coverage of focal buffer canopy.
  2. Thematic_Strata: Biomass and surface moisture stratum percentages inside buffers.
  3. Outliers_Diagnostics: Tukey outlier thresholds and anomaly rates.
  4. Casas_Distancia_Riesgo: Individual record for every georeferenced house with coordinates, minimum distance to water (dist_water_m), nearest water body ID, risk score, risk level, and recommended epidemiological action.
  5. Estratificacion_Riesgo_Casas: Consolidated count, percentage, mean distance, and min/max distance stratified by risk tier.
